A suit of '''dark armor''' was crafted by [[Belia Darzu]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who lived [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the end of the [[New Sith Wars]].<ref name="DARZU">{{CSWECite|I|172|Darzu, Belia}}</ref> Heavy plated and [[Battle armor|specialized for battle]],<ref name="WEAPONS" /> the dark [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was worn by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu while she operated in a [[New Sith|resurgent faction]] of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]-worshipping [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]]. The suit—like most types of [[Sith apparel|Sith dark armor]]<ref name="DSSB" />—was imbued with the power of the dark side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the hands of its creator. To this end, the armor bestowed enhanced stealth capabilities upon its bearer,<ref name="DARZU" /> as well as increased physical strength. Valued at 37,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]],<ref name="DSSB" /> the dark armor was intended for optimal protection against multiple [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] opponents in battle.<ref name="WEAPONS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dark armor of Belia Darzu was first mentioned in the ''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplement published in [[2001]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="DSSB" />
